A_r7.note: current R7 production SQL (captured from the builder)
A_r7.sql:
select "id" from "page_revisions" where ("page_revisions"."created_at" < $1 and (select count(*) from (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" newer
        where newer.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and (newer.version, newer.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit $2
      ) newer_rows) = $3 and not ("page_revisions"."kind" = 'publish' and not exists (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" published
        where published.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and published.kind = 'publish'
          and (published.version, published.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit 1))) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $4

B_r9_any_array.note: R9-2 contract text: = any(array(group by ... having count(*) > k)) first conjunct
B_r9_any_array.sql:
select "id" from "page_revisions" where ("page_revisions"."page_id" = any(array(select candidate_parents.page_id from "page_revisions" candidate_parents group by candidate_parents.page_id having count(*) > $1)) and "page_revisions"."created_at" < $2 and (select count(*) from (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" newer
        where newer.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and (newer.version, newer.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit $3
      ) newer_rows) = $4 and not ("page_revisions"."kind" = 'publish' and not exists (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" published
        where published.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and published.kind = 'publish'
          and (published.version, published.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit 1))) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $5

C_window.note: one window pass, no correlated probes, id = any(array(window)) outer
C_window.sql: select "id" from "page_revisions" where "page_revisions"."id" = any(array(select ranked.id from (select r.id, r.created_at, r.kind, row_number() over newest as newer_rank, count(*) filter (where r.kind = 'publish') over (newest rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding) as newer_publishes from "page_revisions" r window newest as (partition by r.page_id order by r.version desc, r.id desc)) ranked where ranked.created_at < $1 and ranked.newer_rank > $2 and not (ranked.kind = 'publish' and ranked.newer_publishes = 0) order by ranked.created_at asc, ranked.id asc limit $3)) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $4

D1_window_aged_prescan.note: C with window input restricted to parents that own an aged row (retention_idx range pre-scan)
D1_window_aged_prescan.sql: select "id" from "page_revisions" where "page_revisions"."id" = any(array(select ranked.id from (select r.id, r.created_at, r.kind, row_number() over newest as newer_rank, count(*) filter (where r.kind = 'publish') over (newest rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding) as newer_publishes from "page_revisions" r where r.page_id in (select aged.page_id from "page_revisions" aged where aged.created_at < $1) window newest as (partition by r.page_id order by r.version desc, r.id desc)) ranked where ranked.created_at < $2 and ranked.newer_rank > $3 and not (ranked.kind = 'publish' and ranked.newer_publishes = 0) order by ranked.created_at asc, ranked.id asc limit $4)) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $5

D2_window_group_prescan.note: C with window input restricted to parents with count(*) > k and min(created_at) < cutoff
D2_window_group_prescan.sql: select "id" from "page_revisions" where "page_revisions"."id" = any(array(select ranked.id from (select r.id, r.created_at, r.kind, row_number() over newest as newer_rank, count(*) filter (where r.kind = 'publish') over (newest rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding) as newer_publishes from "page_revisions" r where r.page_id in (select cp.page_id from "page_revisions" cp group by cp.page_id having count(*) > $1 and min(cp.created_at) < $2) window newest as (partition by r.page_id order by r.version desc, r.id desc)) ranked where ranked.created_at < $3 and ranked.newer_rank > $4 and not (ranked.kind = 'publish' and ranked.newer_publishes = 0) order by ranked.created_at asc, ranked.id asc limit $5)) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $6
